criterion_text: : A Kill with matching current instance succeeds exactly once, while missing/invalid expected identity on the AI-facing Tool fails explicitly; Server-embedded, Agent-embedded and Standalone routes preserve the same behavior and named-Agent authorization.

verifiers.summary: compiled the nession-protocol lib test binary for the kill contract

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: compiled the nession-protocol lib test binary for the kill contract

verifiers.summary: The Protocol kernel owns the optional kill incarnation precondition and the typed refusal reply

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: the canonical Session kill payloads accept and emit the optional expected_instance_id while legacy name-only payload bytes stay unchanged, and the kill reply declares its error_kind classification

verifiers.summary: compiled the nession-mcp lib test binary for the AI-facing kill Tool

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: compiled the nession-mcp lib test binary for the AI-facing kill Tool

verifiers.summary: The AI-facing kill Tool requires and forwards the caller-observed instance and refuses a missing one explicitly

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: the kill Tool schema requires agent_id, name and expected_instance_id; a present identity is forwarded with the named Agent; a missing or empty identity fails as invalid_argument with no backend call

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: compiled the nession-mcp integration test binary for the four-host equivalence proof

verifiers.summary: All four MCP hosting routes refuse a stale incarnation identically and preserve a matching kill

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: on the same real Agent, the server-embedded, agent-embedded, server-routed standalone and direct-Agent standalone hosts each answered a stale-instance kill as conflict; the current Session stayed listed; reading its instance and killing with that identity succeeded

verifiers.summary: compiled the nession-agent integration test binary for the Agent-embedded Tool proof

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: compiled the nession-agent integration test binary for the Agent-embedded Tool proof

verifiers.summary: The Agent-embedded MCP host enforces the observed-instance precondition with explicit refusals

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946 over the Agent-embedded MCP host on real tmux: missing and empty expected_instance_id were refused as invalid_argument, a stale identity as conflict with the Session still listed under its own instance, and the matching identity killed it
